text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Kyaaa! Fuji-senpai~~♡ I can't wait for 
your next race~!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, little ponies! I will 
definitely show you a miracle. Look 
forward to it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki continues to be the perfect 
star today. Still, knowing how demanding 
that is, I can't help but worry...
choice_data_list:
(I wonder if there's anything I can do to 
help…)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I thought about that, I remembered 
how she had 'cheered me on' back when I 
was overwhelmed by work and having a tough 
time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Attentiveness born of meticulous research. 
A truly helpful care package. And on top 
of that, words of encouragement...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fretting over it might just put pressure 
on her, but if it's smart "encouragement" 
like back then...!
choice_data_list: Alright! I'm gonna cheer like that too!
Alright! I'm gonna cheer like that too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
First, research. I need to get a grasp on 
her schedule and find a time when I won't 
be in her way. With that in mind, I 
casually observe her, and...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
What's the matter? When you stare at me 
like that, I can't look away either.
choice_data_list: Um, it's just... you always seem so busy

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, my days are fulfilling. 
Classes, training, interacting with 
fans... Who knows, I might even be 
prepping some magic tricks?
choice_data_list: Um, do you have some free time...?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, depends on the day, I guess? I often 
get sudden invitations, you see.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Do you need something from me? For you, 
I'd gladly clear my schedule.
choice_data_list: No, I'm alright...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What kind of treat would make her 
happy...? I ponder while having a staring 
contest with the school store shelves.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Hey there, Trainer-san! You look like 
you've got something heavy on your mind?"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ah, were you having trouble deciding on a 
tea? Are you in an adventurous mood today?
choice_data_list: W-Which one do you like?
Ah, which one do you like?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Huh? I pretty much like all kinds of tea. 
Besides, my fans send me tea as gifts 
almost every single day.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, I get to enjoy something 
different every day! I'm really grateful 
for it.
choice_data_list:
(Hmm, looks like there are plenty of 
refreshments...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't even probe properly. Her level 
of flawless attentiveness isn't something 
that can be copied overnight.
choice_data_list:
(Even so, isn't there something I can 
do...?)

(Even so, isn't there something I can 
do...?)

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
You, giving it your all, are more 
beautiful than anyone in the world!
choice_data_list: ("With all my might," huh…)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Maybe that really is the only thing I'm 
capable of. Still, if she says so—
choice_data_list: (Maybe that's my strength...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If doing it perfectly is impossible, then 
I'll just give it my all. That might be 
the greatest support I can offer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And then, I called Fuji Kiseki over. 
Seeing her approach, I puffed out my 
chest. She walked up with a slightly 
puzzled expression.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, sorry to keep you waiting. Oh 
my... you look rather tense.
choice_data_list: There's something I just have to tell you!
There's something I just have to tell you!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
What you want to convey...? Yeah, I'm 
ready to take in whatever you have to say.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Told to do so, I took a deep breath. 
Raising both arms high, I shouted out.
choice_data_list: Go, Fuji Kiseki!!!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ngh...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I swung my arms and cheered at the 
top of my lungs. It was neither graceful 
nor elegant, but it carried every ounce of 
my support.
choice_data_list: Let's go, let's go, Fuji Kisekiiii!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: T-Trainer...?
choice_data_list: *wheeze*, *gasp*...!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Um, what on earth is this...?
choice_data_list: I just really wanted to cheer you on!
I just really wanted to cheer you on!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Support? Ah... Could it be in return for 
last year, perhaps?
choice_data_list: That's true too, but... um...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I told her that while I'm far from 
'perfect,' I want to do everything I can 
to support her with all my heart...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I told her that while I'm far from 
'perfect,' I want to do everything I can 
to support her with all my heart...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Even so, this is just... To have this 
happen out of nowhere...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ......Giggle...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hehe! I see, giving it your all, huh!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you know, that's not something just 
anyone can do. Though you don't seem to 
realize it yourself.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. That thought alone makes me 
happier than anything. Fufu, ahahaha...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Seeing her smile like this is rare... 
Though clumsy, my cheering seemed to have 
reached her."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Then, she pulled something out of her bag. 
Cheers alone wouldn't be enough to convey 
these feelings.
choice_data_list:
Actually, I even wrote you a fan 
letter...!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I-It's so thick...! It's been a long time 
since I've seen something this lengthy.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
To think you'd write a cheer letter to me 
in person, Trainer... Man, anything goes 
with you, huh!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. I'll treasure it and read every 
word.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you really do the most unexpected 
things sometimes.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Being surprised can be fun too, huh. I 
feel like I can work even harder starting 
tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hearing your refreshing, hearty shout made 
me want to shout too.
choice_data_list: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: It gave me so much energy! *Inhale*...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—Fuji Kiseki, fight! Come on, everyone 
together! Oooohhh!!
choice_data_list: …! Whoooaaa!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And her singing voice echoed under the 
overpass. She looked just a little more 
excited than usual.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hey, would you mind letting me hear it 
once more?
choice_data_list: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Is that a no? I was taken by surprise, so 
this time I'd like to appreciate it 
properly.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I want to keep the sound of your cheers in 
my ears. So that I can remember them 
anytime.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Put that way, there was no refusing. As I 
called out with all my might once more, 
she sat on the riverbank and quietly 
listened.
